description: This file implements a PhotosHandler class for an Android app, including data models, permission checks, and methods to retrieve and encode recent photos from device storage, with support for JSON parameter parsing.

classes.name: PhotosLatestRequest
classes.description: Data class representing parameters for fetching latest photos, including limit, max width, and quality.

classes.name: EncodedPhotoPayload
classes.description: Data class representing the encoded photo with format, base64 string, dimensions, and creation timestamp.

classes.name: PhotosDataSource
classes.description: Interface defining methods to check permission and retrieve latest photos.

classes.name: SystemPhotosDataSource
classes.description: Singleton object implementing PhotosDataSource for Android system photo access, including querying media store, decoding images, and encoding JPEGs under a size budget.

classes.name: PhotosHandler
classes.description: Main class handling photo retrieval requests, permission checks, JSON parsing, and response formatting.

methods.name: handlePhotosLatest
methods.description: Handles incoming request for latest photos, checks permissions, parses JSON parameters, and returns photos as JSON payload.

methods.name: parseRequest
methods.description: Parses JSON string into PhotosLatestRequest object with proper defaulting and constraints.

methods.name: queryLatestRows
methods.description: Queries media store for most recent photos, returning their URIs and creation timestamps.

methods.name: decodeScaledBitmap
methods.description: Decodes and scales a bitmap from a URI to a maximum width.

methods.name: computeInSampleSize
methods.description: Calculates sampling size for BitmapFactory decoding based on width.

methods.name: encodeJpegUnderBudget
methods.description: Encodes a Bitmap into JPEG, adjusting quality and size to stay within base64 size constraints.
